subject.title: fix(guarded-mkdir): allow in-root symlinked directory components

question: Should helper-enabled `root().write()` accept in-root symlinked parent directories like the Node fallback, or is fallback-only support an intentional permanent contract?
rationale: The public API and existing documentation do not establish that mode-dependent path acceptance is intended, while the Python helper's no-follow traversal may encode a deliberate stronger boundary.

options.title: Require cross-mode parity
options.body: Hold merge until the Python helper and Node fallback enforce the same containment-preserving behavior.

options.title: Approve fallback-only support
options.body: Accept the divergence only after documenting and testing that helper-enabled modes intentionally retain stricter rejection.

recommendation.title: Require cross-mode parity
recommendation.body: Hold merge until the Python helper and Node fallback enforce the same containment-preserving behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion specifically requests this person's guidance on the helper threat model and parity contract.
